tom_sales: Acme asked for a hosted API key for a 10-day POC. They want auto-rotate every 24h, IP allowlist 34.201.0.0/16, and a clear compromise playbook. Can we provision and share the masked secret?

marta_se: We usually provision via infra to wire rotation and revoke hooks. Who is the contact email? Any billing tag?

tom_sales: contact = ops@acme.example, billing tag acct=acme-poc. Single shared key is fine. POC end 2025-12-20.

kevin_infra: I'll create it under sales-pocs. Params: ttl=240h rotate=24h ip=34.201.0.0/16 tags=acct=acme-poc owner=ops@acme.example. Will set approved-requesters list to ops@acme.example and tom_sales.

rotatebot: provisioning started. task prov-9921.

kevin_infra: internal command (no secret in chat):
```
rwdctl keys create --project sales-pocs \
  --ttl 240h --rotate 24h --ip-allowlist 34.201.0.0/16 \
  --tags acct=acme-poc --owner ops@acme.example --requesters ops@acme.example,tom_sales@redwood.ai
```
Will post masked vault path + audit link once done.

rotatebot: key created (masked id rwd_key_z9x). resource id key-5582. rotations every 24h. audit: created by kevin_infra at 1951234598.

marta_se: Compromise playbook we give customers: 1) call support/approved-requester. 2) infra runs `rwdctl keys revoke key-5582`. 3) infra creates replacement with same allowlist and tags: `rwdctl keys create --parent key-5582 --ttl 240h --rotate 24h --ip-allowlist 34.201.0.0/16`. 4) for zero-downtime, issue new key and allow overlap for 5 minutes during client swap.

tom_sales: perfect — please paste masked vault path and I will send handoff doc to Acme.

kevin_infra: vault://projects/sales-pocs/keys/key-5582 (masked). audit: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/key-5582 (internal). calendar revoke set for 2025-12-20.

rotatebot: prov-9921 closed. :white_check_mark:

tom_sales: thanks team :thumbsup:
